packages.summary: Where your play time goes: your most played games, charted.
packages.description:
A Playtime stats page in the sidebar: total hours across your most played games and a bar chart of the top ten, with a table view of the same numbers. When a session ends, a note says what you played and for how long.

It asks for no permissions: it reads your library through the plugin API like any page does, and nothing leaves your computer.

screenshots.alt: The Playtime stats page: total hours and a chart of the most played games
The same numbers as a table

packages.summary: Runs your games through Feral GameMode on Linux.
packages.description:
Starts games with Feral GameMode's gamemoderun, which asks the system for performance settings while a game runs. Caskade still tracks the game itself.

It needs GameMode installed (the gamemode package of most distributions). It may start processes and change what a launch runs, which is why it asks for that, and it may only look at /usr/bin, /usr/games and /usr/local/bin, read-only, to find gamemoderun. Without GameMode, launches are left alone. Linux only.

screenshots.alt: Installing GameMode: the folders it may read and that it may change what a launch runs
GameMode's settings: turn it off, or name the gamemoderun to use
